clauses.scope_note: Client is responsible for paying Partner applicable fees and taxes related to use of Cohere Products, as set out in the Partner Terms. Failure to pay may result in termination; it does not automatically terminate the agreement.
clauses.condition_explanation: The payment obligation applies to fees and taxes that are applicable under the Partner Terms.

clauses.scope_note: In the course of using Cohere Products, Client may encounter Cohere Confidential Information, which includes the Cohere Products and reproductions, summaries, analyses, or extracts. At Cohere’s request or expiration or termination of the CLA, Client must destroy, return, or delete such information in its possession.
clauses.condition_explanation: Disclosure is limited to what is necessary to comply with applicable law compelling disclosure. The destroy, return, or delete requirement is triggered by Cohere’s request or expiration or termination.

clauses.clause_label: 11(b). Right to Request Partner to Suspend or Terminate Access
clauses.scope_note: Cohere reserves the right to suspend Client’s access or require Partner to suspend it upon Cohere’s determination of a Section 2 breach or unauthorized or illegal use. Cohere may also include measures in Cohere Products designed to verify or prevent unauthorized or illegal use.
clauses.condition_explanation: The suspension right is triggered by Cohere’s determination of one of the stated grounds; inclusion of verification or prevention measures is separately reserved without a stated trigger.

clauses.scope_note: Cohere may terminate the CLA, in addition to other relief, on either specified ground. The breach ground includes a 14-calendar-day correction period after notice.
clauses.condition_explanation: Termination is available if either the uncured material breach/default condition or the specified insolvency-related condition applies.

clauses.scope_note: On expiration or earlier termination of Client’s subscription or license under the CLA, Client must cease use, pay accrued Partner Terms amounts, and remove or delete Cohere Products from the Client Environment within five calendar days. Certification is required if Cohere requests it.
clauses.condition_explanation: These duties are triggered by expiration or earlier termination. Certification is additionally conditional on Cohere’s request.

clauses.scope_note: For Cohere Products, Client is solely responsible for testing an Update received from Cohere, and all such testing must follow the Documentation and Partner’s written instructions. Partner is not bound to provide Support Services when Client operates on a release more than two Updates behind the most recent Update made available to Client by Cohere.
clauses.condition_explanation: The testing obligation applies upon receipt of an Update. The stated Support Services limitation applies when the operated release is more than two Updates behind.
